properties.description: Re-encode facer art to cut ebook/web weight ~90% at unchanged pixel dimensions. Measured: all PNGs are 1024x1536 (~128 DPI at 8x10) — modest, so DO NOT downsize pixels. Cost is encoding: ~2 bytes/pixel PNG on photographic art, 2.5-3.4MB/file, 3.07MB over the wire per illustration on the live site. Convert facer/ to JPEG or WebP; keep lineart/ as PNG (flat line art compresses well). Must update both assets/art/ and book/images/ — they are byte-identical duplicates.

Run and validate the typst PDF export: 'cd book && myst build --typst'. Never executed against this content. Unverified: the plain_typst_book template, the exports/overresponsible-ai-handbook.pdf output path, and the cover: images/cover.png key in book/myst.yml. HTML path is confirmed working; typst is not.

Re-encode facer art to cut ebook/web weight at unchanged pixel dimensions. AMENDED 2026-08-17 per cc_tasks/2026-08-17_addendum_assets_untracked_masters.md: the earlier 'assets/art and book/images must stay byte-identical, change both' convention is DEAD. assets/ is now an untracked local master corpus (lossless PNG, never converted, never committed); book/images/ is the only committed art and holds derived web/PDF-weight copies. JPEG chosen over WebP because Typst pixmap support is PNG/JPEG/GIF only (see cc_tasks/2026-08-17_reencode_art_then_typst_pdf.md). Scope: convert facer PNG masters to JPEG q85 at 1024x1536 into book/images/facer/ ONLY; lineart stays PNG; no mirror-copy step.

Flip project license to CC BY 4.0 International, superseding the prior 'All rights reserved / commercial work, no open license' position recorded in CLAUDE.md and README.md. Per Brock's decision 2026-08-17 (cc_tasks/2026-08-17_license_cc_by_4.md): matches the sibling ai-workflow-design. Scope: LICENSE at repo root with full legal code, README license section, CLAUDE.md License line, book/myst.yml license+copyright keys, and a CC BY 4.0 copyright page in both book/front-matter.md and manuscript/01_front_matter.md.

properties.outcome: DONE 2026-08-17. Converted 26 facer masters + cover to JPEG q85 at 1024x1536 into book/images/ ONLY; assets/ masters untouched and now gitignored. facer avg 3057 KB -> 393 KB (-87%); book/images 130M -> 60M. WebP was RE-TESTED and typst 0.14.2 DOES support it, contradicting the task premise - but WebP has no PDF object type so typst decodes+reflates it (7.6x larger PDF: 2.43MB vs 403KB for the same image). JPEG confirmed correct, for the DCTDecode passthrough reason rather than the stated unsupported-format reason. NEW FINDING: lineart PNG is now the dominant cost at 1936 KB avg (49M of the 60M) - it is not flat line art as assumed. Out of scope here.

DONE 2026-08-17. First-ever typst export succeeded on the first run: myst build --typst -> book/exports/overresponsible-ai-handbook.pdf, 47 MB, 74 pages, Typst 0.14.2. Both previously-unverified config items work as written: the plain_typst_book template (fetched from the MyST template repo) and the cover: images/cover.jpg key in book/myst.yml. PDF encoding audit: 27 DCTDecode objects = 26 facer JPEGs + cover embedded natively without transcode. Visual spot-check passed on cover, a facer page (D is for Doubt) and a lineart page (L is for LLMs). Under the <100MB target.

properties.description: Fix the Seldon rebuild/ontology round-trip defect upstream in ~/Documents/GitHub/seldon. seldon init emitted ontology_synced but the replay dispatcher had no branch for it, so every seldon rebuild silently dropped the ontology to epoch 0 and seldon verify then failed. Audit found 3 unhandled emitted event types, not 1: ontology_synced, ontology_ingested, paper_fix. Fixed in commit 86b039b with 7 regression tests. See cc_tasks/2026-08-17_seldon_upstream_ontology_rebuild_fix_RESULT.md.

properties.outcome: DONE 2026-08-17. Fixed upstream at seldon commit 86b039b. rebuild now round-trips: verified on this project, seldon rebuild alone yields seldon verify all 7 green at ontology epoch 3, event log stable at 96 lines. 7 new regression tests; full seldon suite 669 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated failure (test_build_paper_unknown_xref_passthrough, confirmed pre-existing by stash-and-rerun).
